description: CosmoNext is a team of passionate innovators interested in astrophysics, astronomy, physics, and technology. With experience in AI hackathons, we thrive on exploring complex ideas, solving problems, and turning challenging concepts into engaging solutions. For the Space Mission Design Game challenge, our goal is to build an interactive simulation that lets users design, manage, and test real space engineering trade-offs. We value creativity, open-minded discussions, and strong teamwork.
summary:
VOIDTRACE is an immersive 3D space exploration and survival game where players must rebuild a stolen spacecraft after an alien impostor steals its essential components. Players explore their surroundings, collect missing parts, follow clues, and solve challenges to restore the spacecraft and complete their mission.

To make the experience educational, every collected item features an information panel displayed on the side of the screen, explaining its name, function, and importance in a spacecraft. This allows players to learn about space technology while progressing through the game.

VOIDTRACE combines interactive exploration, resource collection, logical thinking, and educational information to create an engaging learning experience. It aims to make space science more accessible and interesting, especially for younger audiences, while encouraging curiosity about spacecraft, science, technology, and space exploration.
details: VOIDTRACE is a 3D space exploration and survival game where players must rebuild a spacecraft after an alien impostor steals its essential components. Players explore different environments, collect missing parts, follow clues, and solve challenges to restore the spacecraft and complete their mission. Each collected item features an information panel that explains its name, function, and importance in spacecraft systems. This combines interactive gameplay with educational information about space technology. The project aims to make space science more engaging and accessible, particularly for younger audiences. It encourages curiosity, logical thinking, problem-solving, and interest in space exploration. VOIDTRACE uses AI-assisted development through Google Gemini to support game creation. Its creative approach combines a fictional alien mystery, 3D exploration, resource collection, and educational information in one experience. During development, our team considered gameplay accessibility, educational value, user experience, mission objectives, and the importance of making space-related concepts understandable and enjoyable.
